description:
**The road access bridge 1.5km from the trailhead has a Zero Tonne Load Limit, vehicle use of the bridge not recommended. **

An easy to follow 6.9 km trail leads to Assiniboine Lake. The trail is used for an access route for climbers ascending Mount Assiniboine. Add on a short hike to Lunette Lake (trail junction is indistinct).
directions:
Trail Head Location -115.659804 50.791778 Decimal Degrees. From Radium Hot Springs, travel northwest on Highway 93 into Kootenay National Park for 19.9km. Turn right on Settler's Road, drive 12.4km. Turn left on Cross River FSR, drive for 20.1km, following the Kootenay River. Keep left to continue along the river on Mitchell River FSR for another 5.5km. Turn right and drive 4.3km to the trailhead. The trailhead is shared with the Aurora Creek/Marvel Pass trail.

The road is busy with industrial traffic.
TH location -115.656486 50.795410 Decimal Degrees
title: Assiniboine Lake
